Wrecking Pull.name: Wrecking Pull
Wrecking Pull.description: The user tears a car, a steel door or a streetlight loose and swings it into a target across a street. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage to the target and anyone beside them and smashes through a barricade or a wall behind them; held back, the user lets it fall short across the target, pinning them to the ground without crushing until they heave it off with a hard effort or someone lifts it away. Strain: heavy.
